items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I played with Al Cohn, he was a favorite, man I loved that guy.

ctx.x: Like we would never be like that but we like to see someone.

Yeah right. And people listen with their eyes. And hopefully musicians listen with their ears. You know I’ll never forget Al Cohn is probably on that list I played with Al Cohn, he was a favorite, man I loved that guy. And I remember one night we were playing somewhere. Did you know Al or did you ever see him?
I saw him in Rochester years ago.
